note: Seed dataset for the Triperly itinerary engine. Ratings/review counts are illustrative seed values for the demo; replace with live Google Places API data before launch. icons must exist in the front-end ICONS map; colors in ACS; tags in TAGMETA.

venues.name: San Diego Zoo
venues.why: One of the world's great zoos — pandas, a kids' zoo, and a guided bus to save little legs.

hl.stroller: Hilly but paved; the tour bus and moving walkways help with a stroller.

venues.name: Balboa Park
venues.why: Spanish-style courtyards, gardens, and fountains — flat, beautiful, and free to roam.

hl.stroller: Wide, level promenades between the gardens.
hl.naptimed: Shady courtyards make an easy stroller nap.
hl.free: Free to wander the grounds and gardens.

venues.name: Birch Aquarium at Scripps
venues.why: A hands-on tide pool and big kelp tanks with ocean views — compact, indoor, and stroller-easy.

hl.stroller: Step-free galleries and a ramped tide-pool plaza.
hl.indoor: Mostly indoor — a good midday option above the coast.

venues.name: USS Midway Museum
venues.why: Climb aboard a real aircraft carrier with cockpits to sit in — a huge hit with kids.

hl.stroller: An elevator reaches the main decks (the catwalks have steps).

venues.name: La Jolla Cove
venues.why: Sea lions, seals, and tide pools along a flat clifftop path — a calm, free coastal stop.

hl.naptimed: The breezy clifftop walk is a reliable nap stroll.
hl.free: Free to watch the sea lions from the bluff.

venues.name: The New Children's Museum
venues.why: Three floors of hands-on art and play, including a dedicated toddler studio.

hl.stroller: Open, step-free studios with stroller parking.
hl.indoor: All-indoor making and climbing — a great backup.

venues.name: Seaport Village
venues.why: A flat bayfront boardwalk with a vintage carousel and open lawns — free and easy.

hl.stroller: Smooth, level paths along the marina.
hl.naptimed: The waterfront stroll is an easy wind-down.
hl.free: Free to wander; the carousel is a small add-on.

venues.name: Coronado Beach
venues.why: Soft, wide sand and gentle shallows by the Hotel del — a classic family beach afternoon.

hl.free: Free, sprawling sand with restrooms on site.

venues.name: Hodad's
venues.why: A beachy burger institution with a kids' menu and high chairs — laid-back and filling.

hl.kidmenu: Kid burgers and grilled cheese; high chairs ready.
hl.indoor: Roomy indoor booths for a midday break.

venues.name: Old Town Mexican Cafe
venues.why: Tortillas made by hand in the window and a kids' menu — fun and tasty in historic Old Town.

hl.kidmenu: Quesadillas and tacos kids love; high chairs on hand.

venues.name: Pizzeria Luigi
venues.why: Big, simple slices kids actually finish — a quick, cheap refuel.

hl.kidmenu: Plain cheese slices please little eaters.
hl.indoor: A fast indoor stop between sights.

hotels.name: Hotel del Coronado
hotels.why: The iconic beachfront resort — pools, a kids' club, and sand right outside. A splurge, but an unforgettable base.

hotels.name: Hyatt Regency Mission Bay
hotels.why: Waterslides, three pools, and a bayfront setting near SeaWorld — the kids may never want to leave the hotel.

hotels.name: Paradise Point Resort
hotels.why: A 44-acre island of bungalows, pools, and calm bay beaches — spread-out and stroller-friendly.

hotels.name: Embassy Suites San Diego Bay Downtown
hotels.why: Two-room suites and free breakfast on the bay — walk to the USS Midway and Seaport Village.
